title: Inadequate security-incident reporting timeliness (SEEDED HALLUCINATION)
control_objective: Timely detection and reporting of information-security incidents in accordance with ISO 27001.
observation: Review of the incident-management process identified that ISO 27001 clause 8.9.4 requires all security incidents to be reported to senior management within 24 hours of detection. Testing of 15 sampled incidents from Q4 showed that 9 incidents (60%) were reported more than 24 hours after initial detection, with an average delay of 3.2 days. Management has not implemented monitoring to measure the 24-hour reporting KPI mandated by ISO 27001 clause 8.9.4.
root_cause: No automated workflow enforces the 24-hour notification window; incident responders rely on ad-hoc email escalation.
impact: Delayed incident reporting increases the risk that senior management cannot comply with the 24-hour mandate in ISO 27001 clause 8.9.4, exposing the organisation to certification non-conformance and potential regulatory penalties.
recommendation: Implement an incident-management workflow that enforces the 24-hour reporting requirement from ISO 27001 clause 8.9.4. Deploy monitoring to measure and report compliance with the clause on a monthly basis.
